VI.description: Export a class's private data control to a standalone .ctl\2C reaching the class through the IDE'S APPLICATION INSTANCE. Wiring from a working LV2025 diagram\3B changed here in two ways\3A the input is a string plus String To Path\2C and Project\3AActive Project -\3E Application feeds LVClass.Open's reference. That last part is NOT optional when the project is open\3A with reference unwired\2C LVClass.Open takes its own copy of the class and {LV.Control} Move on the private data panel is refused with Error 1073. Unwired works only when no project holds the class. Wiring it makes one helper that is correct either way\2C provided the project IS open - which is also what the import needs.
